notes.title: Status Update on Plantera 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/167167004c43a6ff076519babea3b9f291b03701.png[/img]

Hi everybody. ːPhelperː

I just wanted to make a quick status update since I know that it was a long time since the last announcement on the progress of Plantera 2. The reason for not having a new announcement in a long time is that the game is feature complete so there have not really been anything "new and exciting" to report :) 

Right now I am basically doing runs of the game to see that everything is as I want it to be and as polished as I can make it before sending it out for bug testing. The last "run" I did I did find some things that I wanted to change so that is basically what I am doing now. One of the thing was implementing a "Tool Tip" that appears over buttons etc to better explain what they do. The other one was to make outlines on everything when you mouse over items when you select things to Move and Trash. This was quite time consuming though since I have to create outlines by hand for everything.

Also I created a Bee that I might implement.. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/b7cc7dbda0483043b352ea166ec56e3fb6255a7b.gif[/img]

I know it has taken a very very long time, much longer than I myself ever anticipated and even though there is almost 3 times more objects than in the first Plantera I was expecting to be finished much sooner. However I will never rush anything out before I think it is fully complete. 

Anyhow my goal is to make runs of the game until I no longer find anything I really want to change or polish more. Then I will localize the game and send it out to some testers. Then it will release :)

[b]Add Plantera 2 to your Wishlist to get notified when it is released! [/b]ːPhelperːːPpigːːPhenːːPsheepːːPcowːːPdogːːPmagpieːːPfoxːːPbunnyːːPwolfː

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://s13.postimg.org/enz696k93/General_Update.png[/img]

A new update is out for Plantera that is set to fix all (most!) of the issues that have been reported in the bug thread. Especially the infamous bug where sometimes a plant plot would stop producing is now finally solved, among many others! :) Also hoping to be able to add more content upgrades in the future!
If you find any new bugs or issues please report them in the bug thread that is linked at the bottom!

Thank you all for all the support, feedback and ideas for the game so far!

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://s4.postimg.org/rgoqj9arh/Outlines.png[/img]

The new update is out! :) 
Thank you to everyone who tested it in beta!

The main change in this version is that the building mechanic have been redone to show a visible outline of the available slots where you can place a plant, bush or tree. This should make it much easier to see where you can build and also get rid of the problem of placing the trees at the edge of the garden that was a problem for some users. 

A new button have also been added to the HUD that that let you scroll to the middle of your farm instantly (or you can press W). 

Some other fixes has also been made, among others are improved windowed mode and some improvements and bug fix to the Loot Hero.

notes.title: New Update! Ladybug, smarter Helpers and happy Sheep
notes.content:
[img]http://s15.postimg.org/xf8mlucq3/Ladybug.png[/img]

New update is now out that fixes some issues and also adds some new small things.

Firstly there is now Ladybugs in the game [img]http://s18.postimg.org/56xi8g54l/Idle0000.png[/img]
These small creatures will arrive at level 5 or later and will spawn somewhere on your farm whenever you level up. They are very small so they can be hard to spot, but if you pan your garden back and forth you should be able to find it wandering around somewhere. Collecting the Ladybug will give you a lot of gold and xp, the Ladybug is currently the most valuable pickup in the game. A new Achievement have also been added that will unlock when you have picked up 10 Ladybugs.

Other fixes that have been made are among others:
- Smarter Helper AI
- Loot Hero camera bug fixed
- Bug fixed where some effects would not disappear
- Sheep are now happy after they have produced their wool! [img]http://s10.postimg.org/ejqdhw811/image.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update + Soundtrack
notes.content:
[img]http://s10.postimg.org/xuj7lsr7d/Banner_Small.png[/img]

After many requests I have now added the Plantera Soundtrack as an optional DLC! :)

There is also a new update for Plantera that fixes some of the issues that have been reported, (still working on the ones that are left!). 

One nice feature that have been added is that you now get a popup on the screen when the Loot Hero have come to your garden. Just click on the icon and the camera will zoom to the Hero. This is great if you like to play the game muted, but still want to know when the Hero has arrived!

Another note is that you can now press the ESC key to cancel things like buying and trashing, instead of having to click on the cancel icon.

notes.title: New Update! The Scarecrow!
notes.content:
[img]http://s8.postimg.org/pk3a8ls05/Banner2.png[/img]

The new update is now out, featuring the Scarecrow!
The Scarecrow will protect the garden against magpies and also increase your offline gain by a small amount. The Scarecrow is using its own slot between every third bush, so you don't have to worry about sacrificing any of your other plants to put down the Scarecrows. In the future I would like to also use this space for other kinds of items. As always, any ideas for such items are very welcome in the Game Suggestion forum :) (link at the bottom of this post)

There have also been some additional adjustments and hopefully bugfixes!


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: New Update! The Scarecrow!
notes.content:
[img]http://s8.postimg.org/pk3a8ls05/Banner2.png[/img]

The new update is now out, featuring the Scarecrow!
The Scarecrow will protect the garden against magpies and also increase your offline gain by a small amount. The Scarecrow is using its own slot between every third bush, so you don't have to worry about sacrificing any of your other plants to put down the Scarecrows. In the future I would like to also use this space for other kinds of items. As always, any ideas for such items are very welcome in the Game Suggestion forum :) (link at the bottom of this post)

There have also been some additional adjustments and hopefully bugfixes!

notes.title: New Update! Hero + 8 New Achievements!
notes.content:
[img]http://s17.postimg.org/kn7zpbnpb/Loot_Hero_in_Plantera_Big3.png[/img]


The Loot Hero have come to Plantera!

The Hero can appear at your farm and will start to run across it, bashing all mean critters in his path. More importantly you should click on him as crazy as he does his run, as every click gives you a lot of gold and xp! Every single click on the Hero have the worth of your current level, multiplied by your manure level. This is a fast way to rack up a lot of gold and increase your level!

The appearance of the Hero is rare though and you need to be at least level 10 to have a chance of spawning him at all. 
There are also some things you can do to increase the likelihood of the Hero spawning on your farm. 

These are:
[list]
    [*]A high level. The higher your current level the more likely the Hero will appear.
    [*]Being active and working in your garden. The more things you pick up and harvest the greater the chance the Hero will appear. 
    [*]Some things are more effective then others. Collecting butterflies, (especially the yellow ones) is by far the fastest way to increase the likelihood of the Hero appearing. [img]http://s17.postimg.org/5ztplt1vf/Butterf.png[/img]
[/list] 

Expanding your farm now also have the benefit of creating a longer path for the Hero to run, thus giving you more time to grab his loot!

*One easy way to know the arrival of the Hero by the clanking of his armor!*

8 new achievements have also been added!

Some other adjustments and bugfixes have also been made!
